inspected_sheets.cartographic_notes: Inspected all four panels of the Classic Amazonian ADE Expansion (05_classic_amazonian_ade_expansion.png) and 1000AD population benchmark audit sheet. Observation catchments (n=1.588) span Amazonia, the Brazilian Highlands, Llanos de Moxos, Paraguay and the Guianas seamlessly with zero national border cliffs. Both the kriged intensity surface (Panel B) and popc_1000.png (Panel C) exhibit crisp dendritic fluvial alignment along the Amazon-Solimoes mainstem, Tapajos, Madeira, Negro, Xingu, Marajo, Tocantins-Araguaia, Sao Francisco and Parana-Paraguay corridors plus the Atlantic sambaqui coast, while tapering smoothly to zero in deep interfluvial terra firme and the arid Boreal Chaco with no circular disc artefacts or wasteland leakage (unhab_leak_ratio=0,0003; log_corr_hyde=0,8723).

Inspected all four panels of the Late Pre-Columbian Chiefdoms (07_late_precolumbian_chiefdoms.png) and 900AD benchmark audit sheet. Intensification of Llanos de Moxos raised-field earthworks, Acre geoglyphs, Lower Amazon-Tapajos chiefdoms, Upper Xingu ring-villages, Parana-Guarani corridors and coastal Atlantic settlement belts is sharp and regionally coherent, with smooth gradient transitions (kriged_hp15_mean=0,2059, pop_hp15_mean=0,2169) and no modern urban core backprojection spikes (urban_core_med_ratio=1,484, urban_backproj_p95_ratio=0,767).

Inspected the dedicated kriged Terra Preta (ADE) anthropogenic dark-earth surface (1.kriged_terra_preta/09_terra_preta_ade_anthrosol.png, 37.936 active cells) alongside temporal population benchmarks for 1500AD, 1800AD and 2020AD. Terra Preta peaks brightly along the Solimoes-Amazon varzea bluffs, Santarem-Tapajos, Manaus-Negro confluence, Madeira-Guapore, Marajo, Upper Xingu, Llanos de Moxos, Acre and Guiana river corridors with zero Southern or North-Eastern Brazilian lexical false positives. Temporal evolution cleanly captures the shift from pre-Columbian riverine-ADE dominance (1500AD) to colonial coastal sugar, Minas Gerais gold, Bolivian Altiplano and Guiana polder cores (1800AD) and modern metropolitan South America (2020AD).

Inspected the four-panel end-to-end population_Velkscala verification composite across the PRETA domain for 0AD (2,74M), 1500AD (6,66M pre-Columbian peak), 1800AD (4,74M colonial core shift to coastal sugar, Minas Gerais, Bolivian Altiplano, Asuncion and Guiana polders) and 2020AD (221,94M modern national series). Zero Swiss-cheese zero-holes (holes=0..2), zero national border cliffs, sharp fluvial-coastal continuity and full sub-5k settlement gridcell support (Gatekeeper E2 exit 0).
